# Paden Beck — padenbeck.com

Paden Beck is an 18-year-old founder based in Gilbert, Arizona, building companies at the intersection of premium software and applied AI.

## About

Paden operates across two ventures: a boutique client studio and a B2B SaaS platform. He focuses on implementation — writing code and shipping products — rather than advising. His work spans compliance technology, conversion-focused web development, and AI systems integration for small and growth-stage businesses.

## Companies

### Vigis — vigis.ai
AI-powered regulatory compliance monitoring platform. Vigis scans 10,000+ federal and state regulations and delivers plain-English alerts to small business owners within hours of any change, filtered by their location, industry, and company size. Covers all 50 US states.

### Recorou — recorou.com
Boutique web development and AI systems studio serving Arizona's growth-stage businesses. Recorou builds conversion-optimized websites and custom AI workflow automations — implementation, not recommendations.
